title: How the claims list pages through long lists
body:
### Question

How should the claims list page through long lists? The list is being built now (Feature #20).

### Options

1. Numbered pages
2. A Load more button

### Evaluation

Numbered pages let caseworkers return to a position in a long list. Load more is simpler for claimants, who have few claims.

### Recommendation

Numbered pages, because caseworkers return to positions in long lists.

### Reversible

true
